channels.contract: The fixed dispatcher must wrap raw external input as USER and wrap only actual issued child invocations as FS. These private byte headers are not arbitrary external authentication.
channels.immutable_resume: After GROW the fixed dispatcher must preserve and reuse the same complete readonly input view. Header comparison is continuity checking within that immutable lease, not authentication of replacement bytes.

commands.name: INIT
commands.fields: q8/q9 issued FS session nonces; q10/q11/q12 actual current FS call/system/invocation sequences; q13=3 q14=420 q15=1; no payload or user sequence/lease
commands.effect: adopt an exclusively issued FS session view; owner does not initialize or forge a prior session

commands.name: ATTACH
commands.fields: q7=0; q8 issued DB FD token; q9 DB dev; q10 DB inode; q11 readonly_shm; q12 process-lock bit; payload canonical DB path without NUL
commands.effect: allocate connection first; share node by DB identity; fresh node performs original database FSTAT then SHM open/DMS sequence; reject an already attached DB descriptor token before allocation, matching the retained caller's one-pShm invariant

commands.name: RETRY_DMS
commands.effect: native unixShmMap prelude only; retry node.isUnlocked then clear only after successful SHARED DMS receipt

commands.name: WAL_LOCK
commands.fields: q7 connection; q13 kind; q14 offset<8; q15 count in 1..8-offset; shared count exactly1
commands.effect: native local sibling masks then exact F_SETLK120+offset if required

commands.name: WAL_UNLOCK
commands.effect: shared reference last-holder semantics; successful real unlock precedes mask commit

commands.name: DETACH
commands.fields: q7 connection or0; q17 delete flag0/1
commands.effect: require original valid caller's released masks; remove connection, decrement node refcount; last node optional unlink then one close

commands.name: DESCRIBE
commands.effect: private observation only; no physical syscall

commands.name: FS_ACK
commands.fields: q7=1; q8 exact FS input bytes; q9 full output capacity; q10 full workspace capacity; q11 actual native return; q12 actual invocation serial; payload exact source+full output+full workspace
commands.effect: accept only current pending operation, exact source/header/nonce/call/system sequence and full FS3 completed shape

commands.name: FS_UNKNOWN
commands.effect: permanent refusal with pending state retained; no invented success/retry/close

statuses.0: complete private operation; SQLite code q6 and errno q7
statuses.1: yield exact FS request at output256; full FS input bytes q8/q16
statuses.2: GROW required workspace q10 and output q11, resume identical input

preservation: Only fresh nodes do database permission FSTAT and SHM open; cached nodes retain the first filename and one descriptor.
RW|CREATE|NOFOLLOW|CLOEXEC open falls back to RO|NOFOLLOW|CLOEXEC. EINTR retry belongs to the HIA robust-open sequence.
FD below3 is consumed/closed once, /dev/null is opened without extra CLOEXEC as in original robust_open, and the original SHM attempt repeats. Filler descriptors stay process-lifetime owned by FS.
Nonzero DB mode causes the original successful-empty-FSTAT conditional chmod; failed FSTAT/chmod are ignored in this robust-open substep.
geteuid decides root-only FCHOWN; FCHOWN result is ignored; the same inode's real UID/GID come from completed DB FSTAT.

GETLK at128: observed writer returns BUSY with no shared attempt; unlocked writable obtains EXCLUSIVE then truncates exactly3, retrying truncate EINTR only, then SHARED; readonly unlocked returns READONLY_CANTINIT while attaching the node/connection.
DMS remains live at node lifetime even while all WAL masks are zero. Last connection closes the single descriptor.
All selected SETLK errors map BUSY; no generic busy-handler retry was introduced.
Original primary failures are preserved across ignored close errors. Known cleanup closes once. Unknown outcomes permanently refuse.
